This policy covers the Wings 4 U restaurant ordering website and mobile application serving London, Ontario. It explains what information we use, why we use it and your choices.

Wings 4 U
1544 Dundas St, London, ON N5W 3C1, Canada
Telephone: (519) 488-0800

For privacy questions, access or correction requests, call and ask for the person responsible for privacy requests. Signed-in customers can also use account support. Do not include passwords or full payment-card details in a message.

Information we collect
Accounts: name, email, phone number, password verification data, verification codes and session records. Passwords are stored as hashes, not readable passwords.
Orders and delivery: items, quantities, customizations, order history, pickup/delivery choice, schedule, address, instructions, contact details, notes, payment/refund status and delivery verification. Verification records can include location evidence when the delivery workflow uses it.
Support and feedback: order chat, support tickets, complaints, cancellation/refund requests, ratings, reviews and staff replies. Catering inquiries contain the details you submit.
Rewards and credit: stamp balances, grants, redemptions and ledger history, and recorded wallet credits or refunds.
Security: IP addresses, user-agent information, request/session identifiers, random sign-up device identifiers and security/rate-limit records.

Our restaurant and these terms

These terms describe the Wings 4 U website/mobile app for menu browsing, accounts, ordering, pickup/delivery, support and rewards. Wings 4 U operates at 1544 Dundas St, London, ON N5W 3C1, Canada. Call (519) 488-0800 or use account support.

Review these terms before ordering. The Privacy Policy covers order/account information, Google Maps, cookies and local storage. These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Accounts and your responsibilities

Browse and start a cart as a guest; customer website/app checkout requires sign-in. Provide accurate information, secure your credentials and use an account you are authorized to use. Review orders and promptly report suspected unauthorized use.

Keep contact and delivery details current and reachable. Do not send passwords or verification codes in support messages. Account deletion is available on the website and mobile profile, subject to the status and unresolved obligations explained there.

Placing and accepting orders

Review items, quantities, customizations, fulfillment method, schedule, contact/address details and final total before submitting. A cart, menu preview or quote is not an accepted restaurant order. Submission sends an order request; follow its order number and status for restaurant acceptance and fulfillment.

WINGS4U · ACCOUNT PRIVACY
Delete your Wings4U account?

Deleting your account is permanent. Your profile, saved addresses, login credentials, saved carts, reviews, and other eligible personal data will be deleted. Personal details copied into completed orders and messages will be removed.

Certain transaction, payment, tax, refund, and security records may be retained for legal and financial obligations. These records are minimized and cannot be used to sign in.

You will lose access to saved information and rewards. Deletion will not cancel active orders or automatically refund or transfer wallet balances. Pending payments, refunds, disputes, and nonzero wallet balances must be resolved first.

Sign in, review your account status, re-enter your password, and confirm deletion. Eligible deletion completes when the confirmation succeeds. If something prevents completion, you will see the reason and can try again after it is resolved. Closing this page or cancelling does not delete your account.

This policy covers the Wings 4 U restaurant ordering website and mobile application serving London, Ontario. It explains what information we use, why we use it and your choices.

Wings 4 U
1544 Dundas St, London, ON N5W 3C1, Canada
Telephone: (519) 488-0800

For privacy questions, access or correction requests, call and ask for the person responsible for privacy requests. Signed-in customers can also use account support. Do not include passwords or full payment-card details in a message.

Information we collect
Accounts: name, email, phone number, password verification data, verification codes and session records. Passwords are stored as hashes, not readable passwords.
Orders and delivery: items, quantities, customizations, order history, pickup/delivery choice, schedule, address, instructions, contact details, notes, payment/refund status and delivery verification. Verification records can include location evidence when the delivery workflow uses it.
Support and feedback: order chat, support tickets, complaints, cancellation/refund requests, ratings, reviews and staff replies. Catering inquiries contain the details you submit.
Rewards and credit: stamp balances, grants, redemptions and ledger history, and recorded wallet credits or refunds.
Security: IP addresses, user-agent information, request/session identifiers, random sign-up device identifiers and security/rate-limit records.

These terms describe the Wings 4 U website/mobile app for menu browsing, accounts, ordering, pickup/delivery, support and rewards. Wings 4 U operates at 1544 Dundas St, London, ON N5W 3C1, Canada. Call (519) 488-0800 or use account support.

Review these terms before ordering. The Privacy Policy covers order/account information, Google Maps, cookies and local storage. These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Accounts and your responsibilities

Browse and start a cart as a guest; customer website/app checkout requires sign-in. Provide accurate information, secure your credentials and use an account you are authorized to use. Review orders and promptly report suspected unauthorized use.

Keep contact and delivery details current and reachable. Do not send passwords or verification codes in support messages. Account deletion is available on the website and mobile profile, subject to the status and unresolved obligations explained there.

Placing and accepting orders

Review items, quantities, customizations, fulfillment method, schedule, contact/address details and final total before submitting. A cart, menu preview or quote is not an accepted restaurant order. Submission sends an order request; follow its order number and status for restaurant acceptance and fulfillment.

WINGS4U · ACCOUNT PRIVACY
Delete your Wings4U account?

Deleting your account is permanent. Your profile, saved addresses, login credentials, saved carts, reviews, and other eligible personal data will be deleted. Personal details copied into completed orders and messages will be removed.

Certain transaction, payment, tax, refund, and security records may be retained for legal and financial obligations. These records are minimized and cannot be used to sign in.

You will lose access to saved information and rewards. Deletion will not cancel active orders or automatically refund or transfer wallet balances. Pending payments, refunds, disputes, and nonzero wallet balances must be resolved first.

Sign in, review your account status, re-enter your password, and confirm deletion. Eligible deletion completes when the confirmation succeeds. If something prevents completion, you will see the reason and can try again after it is resolved. Closing this page or cancelling does not delete your account.
